title: Spell is offered/playable with no legal destination
expected: Card ven-148-166 has no hand-authored def; it is parsed at runtime from rulesText via the flexible fallback in /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-move.ts:239-262, whose regex `(?:\s+to\s+(...|a battlefield|...))?(?:\s+.*)$` swallows " where you have units..." and emits `{type:"move", target:{type:"unit",controller:"enemy"}, to:"battlefield"}` with no friendly-units destination filter (verified via getAllCards()). Engine-side, chosenMoveDestinations (riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/targeting.ts:498-540) returns undefined for a plain-string `to:"battlefield"`, so play-spell.ts:427-432 applies no destination restriction. Empirical repro with harness: 2 battlefields, P1 has zero units anywhere, P2 has one unit in base -> game.p1.legal() lists "cast Shadow Dash [dash]" and enumerateMoves(playSpell, validOnly) returns {cardId:"dash", targets:["enemy"], isValid:true}. (Resolution then also fails with "Target zone battlefield does not exist".)
observed: playSpell for Shadow Dash targeting the enemy Recruit was enumerated while player-1 had no units at any battlefield (only enemy token in base).
